game_20260226_003306_g4:3.description: Bottomed Hollow One despite having the Turn 1 Burning Inquiry + free Hollow One combo in hand. Burning Inquiry causes 3 discards, reducing Hollow One's cost by 6 (making it free). This is the deck's signature explosive opening and a key reason to keep this hand.

game_20260217_223017_g8:7.description: Chose to copy Wistfulness with Superior Spider-Man, but since Superior Spider-Man was cast with {2}{U}{B} (no {G}{G} or {U}{U} spent), Wistfulness's ETB abilities don't trigger, making it a vanilla 4/4. Meanwhile, copying Oblivious Bookworm would create a 4/4 with repeatable card draw at end step, which is much more valuable when behind on board and needing to find answers.

game_20260226_003306_g4:9.description: Played Blood Crypt (costing 2 life to enter untapped) instead of Bloodstained Mire, which could fetch a basic Swamp for only 1 life while also thinning the deck and preserving the dual land for future flexibility.

game_20260219_091818_g8:46.description: Player passed priority in postcombat main with Psychic Frog's discard ability available and excess lands in hand. With 4 lands in hand (Bloodstained Mire, Island, Watery Grave, Watery Grave) and only 1 land drop per turn, at least 1-2 of these lands are excess and could be discarded to grow Psychic Frog. Growing the Frog before it can attack next turn is free value, and cards in the graveyard also fuel the flying ability.

game_20260226_003306_g4:14.description: Played Boseiju, Who Endures as a land instead of Eldrazi Temple. Boseiju's main value is its channel ability (destroy artifact/enchantment/nonbasic land), which works from hand. Eldrazi Temple provides {C}{C} for Eldrazi spells, which would accelerate Kozilek's Command and other colorless threats significantly on future turns.

game_20260217_223017_g8:11.description: At 2 life facing a 4/3 flying Enduring Curiosity, choosing Oblivious Bookworm (a ground creature with card draw) over Deep-Cavern Bat is a significant mistake. Deep-Cavern Bat copied by Superior Spider-Man would be a 4/4 with flying and lifelink - it could block the Enduring Curiosity to survive, attack for 4 lifelink to stabilize, AND exile a card from the opponent's 7-card hand. Oblivious Bookworm as a 4/4 can't block the flyer and doesn't help the critical life total situation.

game_20260219_091818_g6:43.description: Cast Young Wolf before playing their land drop, missing the option to play Wooded Foothills first, crack it for a Forest, and then have 2 green mana available to cast Badgermole Cub instead — a stronger play that accelerates toward the Yawgmoth combo by providing mana ramp through its creature-tapping ability.

game_20260226_003306_g5:19.description: Cast Doomsday before playing Polluted Delta from hand. When LED is cracked to pay for Doomsday, the Polluted Delta in hand gets discarded. Post-Doomsday, having an extra fetchland on the battlefield is critical for cracking into the 5-card pile to win the game.
